facts.description:
Limited Edition – Extremely Rare Ground Floor Shop Units with Dual Road Frontages
Prominent frontage of 46 metres wide along New Upper Changi Road and a 90 metres wide road frontage along Bedok Central. This is a once in a lifetime opportunity for investors to acquire a prime road-fronting asset within the bustling Bedok Central locale.
Solid Residential Catchment
Bedok is the most populous planning area with a population of 276,990 as at end of June 2022.
Prime Location with Extremely High Footfall
Situated in the heart of Bedok Central with extremely high footfall. Bedok is known for its vibrant and diverse community, with a mix of public and private housing options. The community is able to access a plethora of dining, retail and entertainment options at the shopping centres and parks in the vicinity.
Excellent Accessibility
Short walking distance to Bedok MRT station and Bedok Bus Interchange. Well-served by major arterial roads and expressways such as New Upper Changi Road, Pan Island Expressway (PIE) and East Coast Parkway (ECP).
facts.keyPoints:
Excellent location at the heart of Bedok Town Centre.
A short 3-minute walking distance to Bedok MRT.
Within a 6-minute stroll to Bedok Mall providing access to retail, and dining amenities.
8-min cycle to EAst Coast Park via Play Corridor , 7-min cycle to Bedok Reservoir
2-min walk to Bedok hawker centre with approx.70 stalls offering wide variety of food.
Ideal for a family living in proximity to several good schools.
Well-connected to various parts of Singapore via major roads and expressways
